browser.source: Actual SWARM Browser start screen captured in project QA
browser.transformation: None. Original PNG bytes copied unchanged; HTML device screen uses object-fit clipping.
browser.privacyReview: Inspected before use; no personal accounts, contacts, emails, secrets or recovery information. Public historical price is visible and captioned as historical.
browser.availability: Browser Windows release only; MacBook frame is a visualization.

messenger.privacyReview: Maya and the conversation are invented demo content, not actual customer data.
messenger.availability: Messenger is desktop only. iPhone concept does not imply a phone release.

devices.rendering: Original native CSS hardware frames, not Apple photography; approximate front-facing device visualization.
